title: Studio list-view inspector: edit a non-grid view's own settings (calendar start date and title, gallery, timeline, gantt, map, chart, tree)
body:
domain:ui#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaJoinvGQSbHeDaWBe

Filing gate: ③ triage-directed. #27836's order said: "if the inspector cannot edit a non-grid view once it exists, editing other types is a separate card". PR #27870's report (6513772908, `out_of_scope_findings`) measured that it cannot.
Reach: Studio › Interfaces › list-view inspector, after "Add view" (PR #27870) creates a calendar, gallery, timeline, gantt, map, chart or tree view; also any such view seeded by a package.
Reader who acts: `domain:ui` (Studio).
Duplicate search: `search_issues` "studio list view inspector calendar settings view type section non-grid" → no open card covering it (#27386 is the console runtime's fixed calendar start date, not the Studio editor).

## Observed
The list-view inspector has a section for the kanban card only. A calendar's `startDateField` / `titleField`, and the gallery, timeline, gantt, map, chart and tree blocks of the view body, cannot be edited in Studio once the view exists. "Add view" asks for the type's required fields at creation, but nothing afterwards.

## Wanted
A section per view type in the inspector, built from the spec list-view schema for that type (fields picked by label), as the kanban section is. ⛔ No hand-kept per-type field list. Landing: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectListViewInspector.tsx`.

Related: #27836, PR #27870, #27521 (row 31).
